motions.item_title: Approve the June 2, 2020 minutes. Board Member Love seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jare…
motions.motion: Board Member Curtis moved to approve the June 2, 2020 minutes. Board Member Love seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham- The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: June 2 minutes approved
motions.summary: Written minutes of the agency board's June 2 meeting were approved as the official record.
motions.impact: Filing work for the agency's own records. It touches the clerk and nobody else.

motions.item_title: Approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah adopting the Fisc…
motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved to approve a resolution of the Redevelopment Agency of Eagle Mountain City, Utah adopting the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Budget. Board Member Burnham seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Agency budget adopted for 2020-21
motions.summary: The agency board adopted the redevelopment agency's budget for fiscal year 2020-2021, unchanged from the version presented two weeks earlier.
motions.impact: This sets the spending plan for the agency's redevelopment money, not for city services, and the motion names no dollar figures. Residents will see no change to what they pay or receive.

motions.motion: Board Member Gray moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:44 p.m. Board Member Clark seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Jared Gray, Carolyn Love, Colby Curtis, Melissa Clark, and Donna Burnham. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
motions.headline: Meeting adjourned at 8:44 p.m.
motions.summary: The agency board closed its June 16 meeting at 8:44 p.m.
motions.impact: Nothing here for residents: this is the line in the record marking when the board stopped for the night.
